i.norm: Verifies that {@link JsonTypeInfo.Value#withPropertyName(String)} produces a distinct Value: the derived Value (with a different property name) is not equal to the original EMPTY Value, in either direction. Also confirms that deriving a new property name leaves the unrelated "idVisible" flag at its default of false.
Differing property names make the two Values unequal, symmetrically.
Changing only the property name leaves idVisible at its default (false).
